parole.significato: comfrey, boneset, knitbone, consound, any herb of the genus Symphytum, specifically Symphytum officinale
parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish قره قاوس (kara kaves, “black comfrey”) and قره قاوز (kara kavuz). The second element قاوس (kaves) is ultimately from Proto-Slavic *gavęzь (“comfrey”), probably via a South Slavic language. The word was apparently later reinterpreted by folk etymology as kara (“black”)
